named_regimes_20yr.name: 1977–1996 Stagflation & Volcker Rate Shock Replay
named_regimes_20yr.description: Double-digit CPI inflation (peaking >13%) and ~14% T-bills; Prop 13 caps assessed growth at 2%/yr while landlord operating costs surge.

named_regimes_20yr.name: 2007–2025 Global Financial Crisis & Bay Area Housing Bust
named_regimes_20yr.description: Immediate 2008 equity (-37%) and Bay Area HPI drawdown with automatic Prop 8 temporary assessment reductions (R&TC § 51(a)(2)), followed by 2012–2021 recovery.

named_regimes_20yr.name: Japan-Style 20-Year Deflationary Asset Stagnation (1991–2010)
named_regimes_20yr.description: Sustained multi-decade equity & land deflation (Nikkei -78% peak-to-trough, persistent negative HPI). One of the rare tail paths where T-bills/renting beat lump-sum equities.

named_regimes_20yr.name: 1929–1948 Great Depression Deflation & Rental Vacancy Spike
named_regimes_20yr.description: Severe early equity collapse (-8.3%, -25.1%, -43.8% in 1929–1931), deflation, and 16% rental vacancy; staged 3-year Treasury entry cuts drawdown sharply.

named_regimes_20yr.name: Immediate Post-Sale Equity Crash (-25% / -20% in Years 1–2)
named_regimes_20yr.description: Tests pure sequence-of-returns risk right after selling Property A in 2045: 3-year staged T-bill entry adds substantial real cushion over day-1 lump-sum equity investment.

named_regimes_20yr.name: Bay Area M7.0+ Earthquake + Insurance Market Retreat
named_regimes_20yr.description: Uninsured 20% structural seismic repair in Year 3 (standard policies exclude earthquake per CDI) plus 2.2x insurance jump and temporary rental vacancy.
